svg.text: Root-system photos against a plain board (method B, after Mori et al., 2022)
Example set-up with illustrative dimensions. Not a real tree.
A · What the photo should look like
Board stands on the ground directly behind the root system; the whole root system and the scale are in the frame.
B · Set-up seen from above: two photos per tree
Camera level, lens at about half the root height,
C · Processing: binarise, count pixels, A(z)
2. Binarise: roots and trunk black, board white.
3. Remove the trunk above the root system.
4. Count black pixels in each height band and
convert to m² with the board scale → A(z).
5. Repeat for the second direction and average.
